Country.evidence_source: We sought permission and assistance from the police headquarters in Accra to obtain access to police suicide data and bereaved families.

Population.evidence_source: We sought permission and assistance from the police headquarters in Accra to obtain access to police suicide data and bereaved families. On meeting willing families, we introduced the purpose of the study and requested voluntary participation after which we interviewed relatives and friends who consented. The opening question was "How would you describe the circumstances that surrounded the suicidal death of your relative or friend?"

Type.evidence_source: The first author (a native Ghanaian) conducted all the interviews, which lasted between 25 min to 3.5 h and occurred between 3 to 18 months after the suicides.

Area.evidence_source: The opening question was "How would you describe the circumstances that surrounded the suicidal death of your relative or friend? Participants recollected important events in the life history of the deceased person and at the same time presented their understanding of the suicide. ... Thus, we ensured that participants placed their accounts of what possibly could matter to the deceased persons during their lives and in the period prior to the suicide in actual experiences.
